error_reason: The agent misinterpreted the question’s temporal criterion by evaluating whether directors had ever held C-suite roles, and seemingly only among current members, rather than checking if they held C-suite positions at the time they joined Apple’s board. This early misunderstanding set the wrong filter for all subsequent verification, leading to an incorrect final answer.

hypotheses.rationale: The agent implicitly constrained the scope to current board members and proceeded to assess whether they had ever held C-suite roles, instead of checking whether they held C-suite positions at the time they joined Apple’s board. This misinterpretation of the task (time-of-joining status and potentially including past members) led all subsequent checks to the wrong criterion and produced the incorrect final conclusion.
